motivation: K01B and its single preregistered 4x-N confirmation failed particle-sampling resolution despite good time-step and wind-reversal controls. K01C therefore changes the estimator, not the physics, to deterministic phase-space quadrature.
interpretation_boundary: Static local truncated-NFW test-particle scattering kernel only. Not a cosmological N-body simulation, total halo drag, galaxy response, survey observable, or detectability forecast.

frozen_physics.kinetic_states: Original E8 4000-q CLASS-normalized F0/F+/F- at m_nu=0.06 eV, source-matched at z=1100.
frozen_physics.halo: Original E28 lower-mass DM14/NFW anchor: same M200c, c200c and r_s at z=.95.
frozen_physics.potential: Spherical NFW truncated at r200=c*r_s, with Kepler point-mass potential outside r200.

estimand.definition: For each state F, D(F;bmax) is the number-normalized incoming-flux-weighted x-momentum-transfer cross-section proxy integrated over q, thermal-direction cosine mu, and impact parameter b.
estimand.formula: D = [integral dq q^2 F(q) integral dmu/2 2pi v_rel^2 mu_rel J(v_rel;bmax)] / [integral dq q^2 F(q)], with J=integral_0^bmax b[cos(chi)-1] db.

deterministic_numerics.turning_point_solver: 80-step bisection for the unique outer radial turning point
deterministic_numerics.outside_r200_extension: Analytic point-mass impact-parameter integral from r200 to 2*r200 and 4*r200.

preregistered_gate.note: PASS establishes only a numerically resolved deterministic local scattering contrast. It is not a total-force or observational significance result.

stopping_rule: If K01C fails the deterministic gate, do not retune quadrature or bmax to recover a contrast. Diagnose and reconsider the local-scattering estimand before any cosmological engine work.
